title: Book Three · Chapter 183: The Early Winter Letter
story:
Two weeks after Ronan sends the school update, the centre confirms its arrival.

He puts the new letter beside the first receipt. The final teacher's note is with the application now. The decision will still come in spring.

On the same afternoon, Mum finishes the last page of the December household review. Dad puts twelve yuan and Mum eight into the study envelope again.

They now keep two hundred yuan for study. Ronan has sixty-nine from work and twenty and a half from the old book sale.

Together, the three amounts are two hundred and eighty-nine and a half. He writes that total on his sheet and keeps the envelopes separate.

No new pay has come to him this term. The English phrase book is beside his own seventy-two line, with the three-yuan cost below it.

Mum puts the household book away. Her customer's jacket is gone now. The woman tried the changed sleeve on the agreed Friday and took it home.

“More room here,” Mum says, touching her own elbow.

Ronan smiles and sets her scissors back in the work box.

Later, he meets Anna near the library. She has brought a drawing book. Her design school has sent no decision yet.

They find a bench in the winter sun. Ronan tells her the final note has arrived at the coast.

“Now you can stop checking that envelope,” she says.

“Only that one.”

She laughs and opens her drawing book. There is a new view of the school gate on the first page.

“Before I forget the shape,” she says.

Ronan looks at the open space beneath the roof. He can remember the first morning there, with a bag that felt too full.

“I still see the door first.”

“I see the windows.”

Anna turns the book toward him.

“Does that window look too wide?”

He looks at the window, then at the door below it.

“A little. The door looks smaller on the page.”

She studies the two shapes. Then she rubs out one side of the window.

Ronan keeps his hand on the corner of the book. A small wind lifts the top page, but he holds it still.

“Now?”

“The door looks right.”

“I asked about the window.”

“I can find a door more easily.”

Anna smiles. She puts a finger over the little doorway.

“Try again.”

He looks at the window.

“That looks right too.”

“Good. I can finish the page now.”

They laugh. She draws the new edge slowly. Ronan waits until her pencil stops before he moves his hand.

The gate on the page is empty. A man passes the bench with a broom. He begins to sweep the path. Anna lifts the book away from the dust.

She moves her hand beside his on the bench. He takes it while they look at the page together.

That evening, Ronan writes his twenty-fourth letter to Leo. He tells him the local term is finished and asks how the four shop mornings went.

He adds ordinary news too: Mum's new jacket, Dad's busy workshop, and Anna's school-gate drawing.

The next morning, he posts the letter from his separate spending money. The saved study amounts do not change.

On his way home, he passes the field. Kai is there with his own ball and one of his friends.

Ronan lifts a hand. Kai sends a short pass toward the path, and Ronan steps onto the grass to stop it before they start a small game.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

confirm＝确认；receipt＝收件确认信；review＝核对、检查；elbow＝手肘。

## 理解问题

1. 学校最后说明到达后，沿海中心已经作出录取决定了吗？
2. 十二月实存后，三份学习钱各多少、合计多少？第二十四封信是否已寄出？

## 读句子

**The decision will still come in spring.**

拆开看：The decision / will still come / in spring.

申请结果／仍然要等到／春天才通知。
